patterns: Most PYQs are report -> publisher one-liners (Doing Business = World Bank; GCR, Gender Gap, TTCI = WEF; WEO, GFSR = IMF; Wage, Social Protection = ILO; HDI = UNDP).
APPSC adds India's/AP's rank items: Doing Business 77 (2018), rank climb, AP 1st in state EoDB; World Air Quality Report 63 of 100 cities.
APPSC G1 2022 trap: Agriculture Orientation Index is FAO, not IFPRI; Doing Business 'ready reckoner for foreign investors', paying taxes weakest.
Other PSCs ask year-specific India ranks in WHR and GHI - volatile numbers; app rightly keeps components (GHI 4, WHR 6, GII 7 pillars) instead.
App MCQs are fewer and well aligned; many PYQs filed here are mis-sorted general-UN/world items.
